The premise says the Canadian dollar was trading at 77.50 cents U.S., meaning 1 CAD = 0.7750 USD. The hypothesis says the US dollar was trading at 77.50 cents Canadian, which would mean 1 USD = 0.7750 CAD, i.e., 1 CAD ≈ 1.29 USD. These are inconsistent: if 1 CAD = 0.775 USD, then 1 USD ≈ 1.29 CAD, not 0.775 CAD. So the hypothesis contradicts the premise.
